purpose: Target-specific, machine-governed dispositions for container-image vulnerability findings. Replaces the bare global .trivyignore, whose entries were CVE IDs with prose governance: a bare ID suppresses that CVE EVERYWHERE, in every image and every package, so it could silently hide a genuinely new occurrence of the same CVE in a different component.
enforcement_model: The gate scans with NO suppression (--ignorefile /dev/null) to obtain the complete finding set, then reconciles that set against the records below. Trivy's own ignore mechanism is never relied upon, so suppression cannot happen without a matching governed record. A record must match EVERY consequence-relevant field of a finding — advisory id, exact configured image digest, exact resolved platform, package name, canonical PURL, installed version, severity and result target. An unmatched finding fails the gate; a record that matches nothing fails the gate as unused.
severity_policy: `severities` is an explicit governed array of the exact severities the record covers. Ambiguous composites such as HIGH_AND_CRITICAL are rejected: a record approved for HIGH must not silently absorb a CRITICAL that appears later under the same advisory id.

records.reason: c-ares 1.34.6-r0 is an OS package in postgres:18-alpine. The fix (1.34.8-r0) is not present in any published postgres:18-alpine build, so there is no patched official image to re-pin to. The finding is DoS-class against DNS resolution.
compensating_controls: PostgreSQL is bound to 127.0.0.1 only (docker-compose.yml publishes 127.0.0.1:5432:5432), so the resolver is not reachable from off-host.
Phase 0 is a LOCAL-ONLY development profile under EXC-P0-004; external or customer-data use is prohibited.
ADR-P0-01 monthly patch cadence re-pins and re-scans as a blocking release gate.

records.reason: Go standard-library HIGH advisories compiled into the upstream gosu 1.19 binary shipped by every current official postgres image variant. gosu executes once at container start to drop root privileges and then exits; the affected surfaces (net/http, net/mail, crypto DoS classes) are not exercised by that use. No patched official postgres build exists.
compensating_controls: gosu runs once at container start and is neither a long-lived process nor a network listener.
Phase 0 is a LOCAL-ONLY development profile under EXC-P0-004.
ADR-P0-01 monthly patch cadence re-pins and re-scans as a blocking release gate.

records.reason: The single CRITICAL Go standard-library advisory in the same upstream gosu 1.19 binary. Held as a SEPARATE record from the HIGH set on purpose: a disposition approved for HIGH must not silently absorb a CRITICAL, so the critical finding carries its own explicit approval and its own severity array.
compensating_controls: gosu runs once at container start and is neither a long-lived process nor a network listener.
Phase 0 is a LOCAL-ONLY development profile under EXC-P0-004; this disposition is invalid for any external or customer-data use.
ADR-P0-01 monthly patch cadence re-pins and re-scans as a blocking release gate.

evidence_binding: Every record cites docs/SCANNER_DISPOSITIONS.md and binds it by exact SHA-256. The gate recomputes the digest from the tracked bytes on every run, so a one-byte edit invalidates the records until re-approved. The previous references to PHASE0_EVIDENCE.md were a general gate summary that did not identify these findings, digests, platform or scanner identity, and so could not be reviewed as the basis for these decisions.
